k-sym-JACKET.title: Jensen Huang comeback jacket coins
k-sym-JACKET.sourceSays: Posts say Jensen Huang is returning as Nvidia CEO and that memecoins like $jacket and $hung rallied on the news; others tie the leather-jacket meme to it.
k-sym-JACKET.reason: Posts of Nov 23 14:00-15:12 UTC tie $JACKET and $HUNG to the claimed Jensen Huang return; the return itself is unverified here, and the Jacket pools are 0.8-1.3h old.

k-jensen.title: Jensen Huang return coins
k-jensen.sourceSays: Posts say Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia CEO, that markets bounced, and that $jensen, $hung and $copium are trending; one says there is still no official Jensen coin.
k-jensen.reason: Several Nov 23 posts describe the Jensen comeback news and name $JENSEN/$HUNG as trending; they are claims, and one notes no official coin exists.

k-white.title: Jensen the White meme coins
k-white.sourceSays: Posts say people are calling Jensen Huang 'Jensen the White' after his claimed return, quoting a Lord of the Rings line, and some expect Elon Musk tweet potential.
k-white.reason: Nov 23 posts show an organic 'Jensen the White' meme with a clear origin (Jensen return plus Gandalf quote); the coins are minutes old and the news is unverified.
